skill.name: maintenance
skill.description: Maintains project memory files by archiving finished Plans.md tasks, splitting session logs, pruning old logs, and trimming state files.
skill.summary: Clean and archive project memory, session logs, old logs, and state files.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backtick formatting or false obfuscation heuristics after manual review. The real risk is semantic: the skill guides destructive cleanup of .claude logs and state files, with user-controlled thresholds that need strict confirmation.

remediation.issue: Destructive log and state cleanup can remove useful audit history or active session context.
remediation.suggestion: Require dry-run output, explicit confirmation, and verified backups before any deletion, truncation, or state-file replacement.

remediation.issue: Free-form retention thresholds can expand deletion scope beyond the documented defaults.
remediation.suggestion: Validate retention values, enforce minimum retention windows, and require confirmation for archive deletion or custom paths.

remediation.issue: Shell examples rely on agents translating prose into commands.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer explicit safe procedures with quoted paths, fixed directories, and no execution of user-supplied command text.

content.value_statement: Long project memory files and logs can slow review and hide important status. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through backup-first cleanup.
actual_capabilities: Parses maintenance subcommands for plans, session logs, logs, state, or all targets.
Checks SSOT sync status before moving completed Plans.md tasks.
Creates timestamped backups before editing large memory files.
Archives old completed tasks into a Plans.md archive section.
Splits session logs into monthly archive files while keeping recent entries.
Prunes old .claude logs and trims large state files with before and after reports.
limitations: It is documentation-driven and depends on the agent following the cleanup steps correctly.
It can delete or truncate local files when used without dry-run review.
It does not update decisions.md or patterns.md directly.
It is designed for repositories that use the referenced .claude memory layout.

use_cases.title: Reduce Memory File Size
use_cases.description: Archive completed Plans.md tasks after SSOT sync, then report line count changes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Shared Project Context
use_cases.description: Split long session logs into monthly archive files before handing context to another agent.

use_cases.title: Maintain Automation State
use_cases.description: Review old logs and large state files, then prune them with dry-run confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Dry Run Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance all with --dry-run. Show what would change before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Archive Finished Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance plans. Confirm SSOT sync first, back up Plans.md, and move only completed confirmed tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Split Session History
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance session-log. Keep the last 30 days and archive older entries by month.

prompt_templates.title: Custom Retention Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance logs and state with dry-run. Use 45 days for logs and ask before deleting or truncating anything.

output_examples.input: Run a dry-run for all maintenance targets.
output_examples.output: Reports each target, planned file moves, planned deletions, backup names, and items that require confirmation.

output_examples.input: Archive old completed tasks from Plans.md.
output_examples.output: Shows the original line count, final line count, moved task count, archive month, and backup file name.

output_examples.input: Clean logs older than the retention period.
output_examples.output: Lists matching log files first, asks for confirmation, then reports deleted and remaining file counts.

best_practices: Start with --dry-run and review every planned delete, move, and truncate action.
Confirm SSOT sync before changing Plans.md or session-log.md.
Keep backups until the cleaned repository has been reviewed successfully.
anti_patterns: Do not run all cleanup targets without reading the dry-run output.
Do not use broad custom retention values without confirmation.
Do not use this skill for implementation, review, release, or feature planning.

faq.question: What files does this skill maintain?
faq.answer: It covers Plans.md, .claude memory session logs, .claude logs, and selected .claude state files.

faq.question: Does it support dry-run mode?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions define --dry-run for listing planned changes before applying them.

faq.question: Can it delete files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can delete old .claude log files and trim state files, so review and confirmation are important.

faq.question: Does it update SSOT files?
faq.answer: No. It asks for memory sync before Plans.md cleanup, but it does not edit decisions.md or patterns.md directly.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I avoid it?
faq.answer: Avoid it during implementation, code review, release work, and new feature development.
